meaning:
κατα-παύω
[in LXX for נוּחַ, שָׁבַת, etc. ;]
1. trans.,
(a) to cause to cease, restrain: Act.14:18;
(b) to cause to rest: Heb.4:8.
2. Intrans., to rest: before ἀτό, Heb.4:4 (LXX), Heb.4:10.†
(AS)
glosses: paul and barnabas could hardly stop

renderings.bsb: Paul and Barnabas could hardly stop

elsewhere.note: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.
For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”
